blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — With 99 days to go before Christmas, a stall on the second floor of the Mandaue City Public Market has started selling handmade parols as preparations for the holiday season get underway. Sixty-year-old Imelda Rolcales has been making parols for more than 20 years as a source of livelihood. She said she starts preparing the bamboo frames as early as June to ensure she has enough lanterns to sell as the Christmas season approaches.
